name: ChatLab – AI Chatbot for WordPress and WooCommerce
author: ChatLab.com

sections.description:
AI Chatbot for WordPress & WooCommerce

ChatLab is an AI chatbot for WordPress that learns from your website content and answers visitor questions about your services and pages. For stores, it also integrates with WooCommerce to help customers find products, check stock, track orders, and get AI-powered recommendations that boost sales. No coding required. Free trial. Powered by ChatGPT and Gemini. Also includes Email Copilot to support answering emails.

Start with a free trial — no credit card required.

Why ChatLab?

  • 5-minute setup — Install the plugin, connect your account, and your chatbot is live. No coding, no complicated configuration.
  • Trained on your content — The AI learns from your website, uploaded files, or manual Q&A entries to deliver accurate, relevant answers.
  • Trusted by 1,000+ businesses — Powering millions of conversations for brands like Olimp Labs, GetTested, and Black Mountain Honey.
  • Proven results — Customers report up to 70% reduction in support emails and 80% of inquiries handled automatically.

WordPress Integration (Free Plan)

Works with any ChatLab account, including the free plan:

  • AI-powered customer support — Your chatbot answers visitor questions instantly, 24/7
  • Automatic training — Learns from your website content and stays up-to-date (up to 10 pages on the ChatLab free plan)
  • Multilingual support — Engages customers in 85+ languages with automatic detection
  • Customizable appearance — Match your brand with custom colors, avatar, and chat icons

Starting from the Basic plan:

  • Unlimited pages to train on
  • 2,400 messages/month included
  • Lead generation — Collect emails and phone numbers from interested visitors
  • Live chat fallback — Seamlessly transfer conversations to human agents when needed

WooCommerce Integration (Standard Plan)

For WooCommerce stores, ChatLab becomes your AI-powered sales assistant:

  • 11,000 messages/month included
  • Real-time product search — Customers find products using natural language like “red dress under $100”. Searches your live WooCommerce catalog via REST API — no indexing or syncing required.
  • Order tracking — Customers check order status, shipping details, and tracking numbers by providing their email — no login required.
  • Inventory queries — Real-time stock availability, restock notifications, and alternative product suggestions when items are out of stock.
  • Product recommendations — Intelligent suggestions based on customer queries to increase conversions by up to 30%.
  • Category browsing — Customers navigate your product catalog through natural conversation.

Start with a free trial of the Standard plan to test all WooCommerce features at no cost.

  • WooCommerce Integration Guide
  • ChatLab Website
  • Documentation

Full Feature List

Core (WordPress)

  • AI chatbot for customer support — answers questions 24/7
  • Training from your content — website pages, uploaded files, or manual Q&A
  • Multi-language support — 85+ languages with automatic detection
  • Customizable appearance — colors, avatar, chat icons
  • Chat history & improvements — review conversations and refine answers
  • Lead generation — collect emails and phone numbers
  • Live chat fallback — transfer conversations to human agents
  • Analytics & insights — understand what customers ask and optimize content
  • Custom API Actions — connect to ERP/CRM or any backend via API calls

WooCommerce (Standard Plan)

  • Real-time product search (REST API) — no indexing or syncing required
  • Inventory queries — stock checks and alternative suggestions
  • Order tracking — status, shipping details, tracking numbers (by email; no login required)
  • AI-powered product recommendations to increase conversions
  • Category browsing via natural conversation

What Website Owners Say

“The implementation process went very smoothly and professionally.”
— Marketing Department, “Wieliczka” Salt Mine

“I must say your AI support is well-trained.”
— Customer feedback from inMusic post-support surveys

What Store Owners Say

“The number of emails has dropped by around 40% and inquiries forwarded to the customer service team have decreased by 70%. Implementing ChatLab has been a major success.”
— Dawid Kurek, E-Commerce Manager at Olimp Labs

“Buzz handles 80% of clients’ inquiries instantly and cuts routine email volume by over 70%. He never sleeps, so our 30,000 monthly visitors get real-time answers around the clock.”
— Laurence Edwards, Owner at Black Mountain Honey

Pricing

  • Free — 30 messages/month, 1 chatbot. Perfect to get started and see ho it works
  • Basic ($18/month) — 2,400 messages/month, 2 chatbots, live chat, file uploads.
  • Standard ($95/month) — 11,000 messages/month, 5 chatbots, WooCommerce integration, analytics, custom APIs.
  • Premium ($360/month) — 50,000 messages/month, 25 chatbots, white-label, custom domains.

All paid plans include a free trial — no credit card required.

Compatible Platforms

ChatLab also integrates with Shopify, PrestaShop, CS-Cart, BaseLinker, Wix, and more. Works with WooCommerce 5.0+ and WordPress 5.8+.

This plugin utilizes ChatLab services to deploy a pre-trained chatbot on your website, leveraging the data you’ve uploaded to the ChatLab application. For more information on privacy and terms of service, please refer to our dedicated sections.
sections.installation:
Quick Setup (Recommended)

  1. Install & Activate — Install the ChatLab plugin from the WordPress plugin repository and activate it.
  2. Choose Integrations — Select WordPress integration (always included) and optionally WooCommerce integration.
  3. Connect Your Account — Click “Continue” to connect your ChatLab account. Don’t have one? You’ll be able to create a free account during setup.
  4. Done! — Your AI chatbot is live on your website, trained on your content and ready to assist visitors.

The plugin automatically handles everything: account connection, chatbot creation, initial training, and WooCommerce API key generation (if selected).

Manual Setup

  1. Create a ChatLab Account — Sign up at ChatLab.com and create your chatbot.
  2. Get Your API Key — Copy the API key from your ChatLab dashboard.
  3. Configure the Plugin — Go to ChatLab > Settings in your WordPress admin and paste the API key.
  4. Verify — Check that the chatbot appears on your website.

WooCommerce Integration (Optional)

If you selected WooCommerce integration during quick setup, the plugin automatically creates the API keys and configures everything for you.

For manual setup, follow the WooCommerce Integration Guide.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills?

No. The plugin provides a one-click setup experience. Install, connect your account, and your chatbot is live. No coding or technical knowledge required.

Is there a free trial?

Yes! You can start with a free trial that includes all features — no credit card required. The free plan gives you 30 messages per month to test the chatbot on your site.

How does WooCommerce product search work?

ChatLab searches your WooCommerce products in real-time using the REST API. No indexing or catalog syncing required. When a customer asks about a product, the AI queries your live WooCommerce database and provides accurate, up-to-date results including pricing, availability, and product details.

Do I need to index my products?

No. ChatLab connects directly to your WooCommerce store via the REST API and queries products in real-time. Your chatbot always has access to the latest product information without any manual syncing.

Can customers track their orders?

Yes. Customers can check order status by providing their email address. ChatLab retrieves order information from WooCommerce including status, shipping details, and tracking numbers — no customer login required.

What WooCommerce versions are supported?

ChatLab supports WooCommerce 5.0+ and WordPress 5.8+. As long as your WooCommerce installation has the REST API enabled (which is standard), ChatLab works seamlessly.

What languages are supported?

ChatLab supports 85+ languages with automatic detection. The chatbot understands customer questions in any language and responds in the same language — perfect for international stores.

Can the chatbot switch to a live human agent?

Yes. ChatLab includes live chat fallback. If the chatbot encounters a situation where human support is needed, it transfers the conversation to a live agent seamlessly.

How can the chatbot help increase sales?

ChatLab engages customers in real-time: answering product questions, recommending related products, and assisting with checkout. Customers report up to 30% increase in conversions. The chatbot also collects leads for future sales opportunities.

What subscription do I need for WooCommerce?

WooCommerce integration requires a Standard ($95/month) or Premium ($360/month) subscription. You can start with a free trial to test all features before subscribing.
